name: Halftone Collage
tagline: gbro's halftone paper collage: milk field, deep-green accent, cut-letter type, stop-motion landings on a 10 fps grid.

motion.direction: gbro halftone collage, info edition. Paper cards (`mar`, 2 px knife-edge highlight, one-direction shadow) hand-tilted ±0.3–1.6° on a milk field; Inter 600 as cut letters (no bold, no stroke), NUMBERS are the strongest object (168 px, −0.05 em) as `counter`s; mono kicker + a 5 px rule on every frame. Everything lands in held poses (stop-motion, 10 fps grid): landing 0.3 s in 3 steps, slide-in 0.4 s in 4, counters in 24 steps; hold ≥ 0.8 s after each landing; one main motion per card, never repeated. Exactly one accent annotation per frame (box / underline / lead in `ter`, < 10 % area). No gradients, no icons, no fades.
